data.description: Metal Fragments, or frags, are a core resource in Rust, used in 317 recipes such as 5.56 Rifle Ammo, Pistol Bullets and Nailgun Nails. You get them by smelting [Metal Ore](/items/metal-ore), or buy 250 for 25 scrap at Outpost. Recycling works too, with 356 items breaking down into frags, and the [Giant Excavator Pit](/monument/giant-excavator-pit) produces them. [Minecarts](/world/minecart) and [Normal Crates in caves](/world/crate-mine) have about a 15% chance of 30-49.
data.name: Metal Fragments
